patches.title: feat db hosts add DatabaseProvisionerInterface Mysql
patches.description: Extract MySQL provisioning SQL into MysqlProvisioner behind a strategy interface (DatabaseProvisionerInterface) with ProvisionerFactory for driver resolution. Includes safe identifier quoting and literal escaping helpers.

patches.title: refactor db hosts rewire services to use Provisioner
patches.description: Rewire DatabaseManagementService, DatabasePasswordService, HostCreationService, and HostUpdateService to use ProvisionerFactory instead of direct DatabaseRepository SQL. Enforces testConnection permission checks before persisting host records.

patches.title: fix db hosts driver aware testConnection remove cred
patches.description: Make Admin DatabaseController testConnection driver-aware with correct success/failure semantics, handle RuntimeException from permission checks, remove credential logging bug, and clean up DatabaseRepositoryInterface.

patches.title: feat db hosts add driver column migration model upda
patches.description: Add driver column to database_hosts table (default mysql), update DatabaseHost model/factory, and make DynamicDatabaseConnection driver-aware with MySQL and PostgreSQL config profiles. Throws on unsupported driver values.

patches.title: feat db hosts add PostgresProvisioner with external
patches.description: PostgreSQL provisioner with role-based auth, schema-level grants, ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES, safe identifier/literal quoting, SQLSTATE-based race condition handling, and external transaction support. Includes orphaned model cleanup on partial failure.

patches.title: feat db hosts wire driver through API validators tra
patches.description: Wire driver field through API transformers, make remote field optional for PostgreSQL hosts, update DeployServerDatabaseService and request validators for multi-driver support.

patches.title: feat db hosts add driver aware React frontend for da
patches.description: Add driver field to ServerDatabase interface, driver-aware JDBC connection strings (mysql/postgresql), conditional Connections From display, and driver badges in the client UI.

patches.title: feat db hosts update Blade templates for multi drive
patches.description: Add driver dropdown to host creation modal, driver badges in admin tables, auto-port switching, driver-aware permission help text, and XSS-safe test connection feedback in Blade templates.

patches.description: Add GitHub Actions workflow for building and publishing Docker images.
